gloss: plunge pool; basin at the foot of a waterfall

definitions.gloss: plunge pool; basin at the foot of a waterfall
definitions.explanation: The deep pool of water formed at the base of a waterfall by the force of the falling water. A natural feature found at many famous waterfalls.

examples.japanese: {滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たかった→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
examples.english: The water in the plunge pool was cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: The children are swimming in the plunge pool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}→遊歩道：23484_yuuhodou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}って→下る：03913_kudaru⟧いく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧そば⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{水|みず}しぶき→水しぶき：20240_mizushibuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you walk down the trail, you can get right up close to the plunge pool, and the spray hits your face.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{滝|たき}→滝：02219_taki⟧ (waterfall) and {壺|つぼ} (pot, basin). The metaphor of a pot captures the round, deep shape of the pool carved out by falling water.

USAGE:
Frequently encountered in nature tourism, hiking guides, and descriptions of scenic spots. Japan has many famous waterfalls (⟦{名瀑|めいばく}→名瀑：24656_meibaku⟧), and the {滝壺|たきつぼ} is often highlighted as a destination point on hiking trails. Some {滝壺|たきつぼ} are deep enough for swimming in summer, while others are used for ⟦{滝行|たきぎょう}→滝行：24655_takigyou⟧ (waterfall meditation practice).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall into the plunge pool
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: to swim in the plunge pool
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}さ→深さ：05328_fukasa⟧: depth of the plunge pool
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{下|お}りる: to descend to the plunge pool

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{滝|たき}→滝：02219_taki⟧: waterfall — the waterfall itself; {滝壺|たきつぼ} is specifically the pool at its base
- ⟦{淵|ふち}→淵：13456_fuchi⟧: deep pool (in a river) — a general term for a deep, still section of a river, not necessarily at the base of a waterfall
- ⟦{渓流|けいりゅう}→渓流：15855_keiryuu⟧: mountain stream — the flowing water in a valley or gorge
